title: Smoother and slower cluster-mode transitions in Orderbook Heatmap

requirements.summary: Derive cluster-mode triangle transition duration from the selected Update Interval to slow and smooth size changes without altering polling cadence.
acceptanceCriteria: When Rendering Mode is set to "Cluster", triangle shape/size changes are visibly smoother and slower (no rapid per-second "jumping") at the default settings.
Transition/animation duration used by the canvas is derived from the currently selected Update Interval (e.g., a large fraction of the interval) and updates immediately when the interval changes.
The polling behavior (snapshot fetch cadence) continues to follow the selected Update Interval; only the visual transition speed is adjusted.

file_operations.description: Replace the fixed TRANSITION_DURATION with a prop-driven (or otherwise externally configurable) transition duration that is computed from the selected Update Interval when renderingMode is "cluster" (e.g., clamp to a safe min/max and use a large fraction of the interval). Ensure the duration change takes effect immediately (including mid-transition) by referencing the latest duration value in the animation loop (e.g., via a ref) so triangles grow/shrink gradually instead of jumping.

Pass the currently selected Update Interval (and/or a derived transitionDurationMs) down to OrderbookHeatmapCanvas so the canvas animation duration stays aligned with the user's interval selection, while leaving the existing polling cadence (useHyperliquidOrderbook interval) unchanged.

requirements.summary: Add slower Update Interval dropdown options (10s, 15s) and set a slower default interval for the Orderbook Heatmap view.
acceptanceCriteria: The Update Interval dropdown includes additional slow options beyond the current 1s/2s/5s (at minimum: 10s and 15s).
The default Update Interval value in `frontend/src/components/OrderbookHeatmapView.tsx` is set to a slower setting (>= 5s).
All user-facing labels for these options are in English (consistent with the current control labels).

file_operations.description: Extend INTERVAL_OPTIONS to include slower options (at minimum 10s and 15s) with English labels, and change the initial interval state to a slower default (>= 5000ms) so the first experience is not per-second updates.
